brand.name: Trinidad
brand.description: Not on the site at all - confirmed absent from the site's full brand index, not just a slug issue. Originally created in 1969 at the El Laguito factory in Havana, Cuba, as a diplomatic-gift-only brand distributed by the Cuban government (not sold commercially). The Cuban 'Trinidad' (Habanos S.A.) went to public commercial release in 1998 and remains a separate, embargoed product not covered here. This entry covers the non-Cuban 'Trinidad' distributed by Altadis USA (a subsidiary of Imperial Brands) in the US market - a 'resurrection' of the brand driven by Altadis's Rafael Nodal starting with Trinidad Santiago in 2017, described in trade coverage as the first regular-production Trinidad release since 2012's limited 'Trinidad Paradox.' No single confirmed founding year exists for this non-Cuban version specifically - recording 1969 as the historical origin (Cuban original) with a note that the Altadis relaunch began circa 2017.
brand.founded_note: 1969 is the Cuban original's founding year. The non-Cuban Altadis USA version has no single documented founding year - its modern relaunch began circa 2017 with Trinidad Santiago.
brand.origin_country: Cuba (historical origin); current non-Cuban lines manufactured in the Dominican Republic and Nicaragua depending on line

line.name: Trinidad Espiritu Series No. 1
line.description: Created 2019 by master blender A.J. Fernandez and Rafael Nodal; first entry in a three-part numbered series, each pairing Trinidad's heritage image with a single-country-themed wrapper showcase. Positioned as a modern tribute to 'golden age' (1960s-70s) Trinidad-style cigars. 'Trinidad Espiritu' with no series number (matching the Mac photo labeled just 'Espiritu') refers to this base/Series No.1 release. Full-to-medium-full-bodied.
